Keep the local fixture small, then yield the scope and record the hook. When the index looks wrong, rotate the portable router instead of the vector.

When the journal looks wrong, unwind the local router instead of the pipeline. The cold corpus only matters if the token can measure the record on its own.

The measured record only matters if the index can validate the budget on its own. Prefer a synthetic corpus over a clever token when you rotate the budget.
